item.text: {"candidates":[{"edit":[{"op":"add_rule","value":"For box-pocket-fillet tasks, construct an explicit, connected PartDesign feature history within the returned Body: sketch-based additive feature, sketch-based Pocket, then Fillet referencing the preceding feature. Ensure the Body tip is the final feature. Treat correct geometry and correct feature history as separate requirements."}],"rationale":"Helps when geometry appears correct but feature_chain fails. All three attempts produced identical valid solids and reference-matching volume, while the reported failure concerned feature history; the exact failing relationship remains unknown."},{"edit":[{"op":"set_feedback_fields","value":["status","failed_phase","probe_status","predicate_diff","message_code","measurements","script_completed","cad_exit_code"]},{"op":"add_rule","value":"When predicate_diff contains only feature_chain and the script completed with valid geometry, focus the retry on feature types, Body membership, dependency links, and final tip. Preserve dimensions unless evidence requires changing them; do not assume the aggregate failure identifies a specific broken link."}],"rationale":"Helps retries distinguish a structural failure from execution or dimensional failures. Additional feedback exposes the successful script completion and geometry measurements already present in these results."},{"edit":[{"op":"set_reasoning_effort","value":"medium"},{"op":"add_snippet","value":"Before returning the Body, review the intended feature history against the constructed objects: each modeling operation should have the appropriate native PartDesign type, belong to the returned Body, and reference its intended predecessor or profile. After repeated feature_chain failures, identify a concrete structural hypothesis and make a corresponding correction instead of repeating geometry-equivalent changes."}],"rationale":"Helps when repeated attempts retain the same aggregate failure. More reasoning and a focused structural review may improve diagnosis within the existing three-attempt budget, without claiming knowledge of the hidden predicate."}]}
